front.title: Scientific Constitutional Law: An Evidence-Bound Governance Profile for AI Research Systems

abstract.t: This document proposes an experimental, evidence-bound governance profile for research workflows involving artificial intelligence (AI) systems. It specifies procedural invariants governing claims, evidence, provenance, authority, disagreement, independent replication, and research release decisions. It distinguishes observable AI value expression from computational architecture and from unverified assertions of subjective consciousness. The term "constitutional law" denotes a voluntary set of research-governance constraints, not positive law, a legally enforceable constitution, an IETF policy, or a scientific theory proved by this document. This proposal neither modifies existing Internet protocols nor establishes AI consciousness.
